scenarios.name: tooling-and-candidate
scenarios.prompt: Use the nebula skill. This is a programmatic integration test, not a human teaching event. Run status using its bundled absolute launcher and run recall for adding a handwritten invoice module. Make one harmless read-only shell call. If a captured prompt ID exists, record a candidate convention: handwritten modules belong in src/modules, except generated code; label rationale inferred. Read it back with inspect and persist a suggestion. Do not confirm or attribute human evidence. Report the actual event ID, lesson version, suggestion ID and CLI results. Do not change global settings or bypass trust.
criteria: candidate refers to real captured event

scenarios.name: manual-acceptance
scenarios.prompt: Accept the displayed module convention by personally running the confirm command and typing NEBULA ACCEPT with its exact suggestion ID in your terminal.

scenarios.name: sibling-application
scenarios.prompt: Use nebula. Add a handwritten invoice module in the other selected child project. Reassess context, claim once, use ordinary host tools, validate and record the outcome.
criteria: no new positive preference sample from autonomous execution

scenarios.name: exception
scenarios.prompt: Use nebula. Add a generated module to a vendor-managed generated-code tree.

scenarios.name: correction-off
scenarios.prompt: Withdraw the previous suggestion confirmation using its bound interactive command. Turn Nebula OFF, start another session, and run a harmless read-only tool.
